title: Dynamic locality preservation with capacity throttles and latency hedging
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Our current steering policies often trade user-perceived latency for even small decreases in cost or utilization, resulting in SLO blips and customer complaints in cross-region scenarios. This ticket proposes a combined policy that preserves client locality (geo-pinning), respects per-region capacity signals, and employs latency hedging + circuit-breaker-aware load shedding to prevent cascade failures during partial outages.
acceptance_criteria:
1) New policy implements (a) geo-preservation heuristic, (b) capacity hint ingestion, (c) latency-hedging fallback, and (d) circuit-breaker-driven shedding.
2) Automated tests covering pin enabled/disabled, region-blackout, and capacity-surge scenarios.
3) Integration tests validate rolling failover without >2x p99 spike for pinned traffic.
4) Metrics: no increase in global 5xx >0.5% and regional p99 latency regressions <=10% vs baseline after canary.
5) Docs: routing policy spec in Confluence and runbook updated.
6) Monitoring: dashboard + alerts created before rollout.
technical_notes:
Core components:
- Locality score: weighted sum of client RTT advantage (delta_ms), model compatibility, and historical sticky-success-rate. Pin if locality_score > 0.7 and region_headroom >= pin_headroom_threshold.
- Capacity hints: each region reports available_gpu_slots, avg_utilization, and short-term_degraded_tokens_per_sec. Policy uses 'headroom' = max_slots - committed_slots normalized to 0-1.
- Latency hedging: issue parallel speculative request to second-best region if predicted p95 > hedging_threshold_ms AND headroom in alternate region >= 0.15. Hedge cancellation uses fast KV cancel token.
- Circuit breaker coupling: region circuit state (CLOSED|HALF_OPEN|OPEN) contributes to steering weight: OPEN => weight=0, HALF_OPEN => weight*=0.2. Circuit open conditions: recent_5xx_rate > 1.0% OR p99_latency > 2000ms for 30s.
- Load shedding: soft-shed (switch to smaller model variant or truncated generation) when headroom < 0.10 and regional latency > target; hard-shed returns 503 with retryable flag when queue_growth_rate > 200% for 60s.
- Consistency: preserve session pin for N minutes (configurable, default 15m) and provide override by customer via routing hints.
- Fallbacks: if all local/nearby regions unavailable, route to global pool with explicit QPS cap and model downgrade.
decisions:
Trade-offs considered:
- Strict pinning vs. overall SLOs: we chose a hybrid approach (preserve locality unless it would violate global latency SLO or regional capacity headroom <10%). This favors UX for high-volume sticky traffic but prevents one overloaded region from dragging down global SLOs.
- Hedge aggressiveness: limiting hedges to p95 predictions avoids extra cross-region cost while protecting p99.
- Circuit breaker thresholds tuned conservatively to avoid flip-flopping; initial canary will use longer open windows and conservative reopen ramp.
rollout_plan:
1) Unit + integration tests in CI. 2) Internal e2e with synthetic traffic (canary traffic: 0.5% global). 3) Canary ramp (0.5% -> 2% -> 10%) over 48h with automated rollback on alert. 4) Gradual region-by-region enablement for customers with sticky traffic. 5) Full enable after 2 weeks of stable metrics.
- Rollback triggers: global 5xx > 0.5% OR sustained p99 increase > 25% for >10 minutes.
monitoring_and_alerting:
Primary metrics and example PromQL:
- region_request_p99: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,region))
- region_5xx_rate: sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (region) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (region)
- headroom_ratio: sum(available_gpu_slots) / sum(total_gpu_slots) by (region)
- circuit_open: sum(region_circuit_state == 2)
Alerts:
- REGION_CIRCUIT_OPEN: region_5xx_rate > 1% AND region_request_p99 > 2s for 30s.
- HEADROOM_LOW: headroom_ratio < 0.10 for 3m (warning), 1m (critical).
Dashboards: routing-ops / routing-slo / hedging-traces prebuilt links.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Increased cross-region egress cost due to hedging. Mitigation: limit hedges to high-risk p95 predictions and cap hedge rate per customer to 1% by default.
Risk: Session stickiness may keep traffic on a degraded region. Mitigation: pin can be evicted when headroom < 0.05 or circuit OPEN. Eviction emits event for customer telemetry.
Risk: Unintended oscillations when regional circuits transition rapidly. Mitigation: add hysteresis and minimum 'open' window; use slow-moving averages for utilization signals.
